# Living Stack Community

> Free, local, seven-tool MCP server that makes an agent prove its work: open a scoped session, authorize each action, record typed evidence, and check a claim against that evidence before calling the work done.

- Install (Claude Code): `claude mcp add living-stack -- npx -y github:equinoxaifinance-rgb/living-stack-community`
- One-click Claude Desktop bundle (.mcpb) and SHA-256: see server.json and the GitHub releases
- MCP registry name: io.github.equinoxaifinance-rgb/living-stack
- Requires Node.js 22+. No network calls, no telemetry; state is local and stored as SHA-256 digests.

## Tools
- livingstack.status
- livingstack.session_start
- livingstack.session_status
- livingstack.authorize_action
- livingstack.record_outcome
- livingstack.check_claim
- livingstack.session_close
